title: Robust Mechanism Design with Anonymous Information
abstract: arXiv:2602.20429v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In practice, auction data are often endogenously censored and anonymous, revealing only limited outcome statistics rather than full bid profiles. We study robust auction design when the seller observes only the distribution of a single anonymous order statistic of the bidders' values and seeks to maximize worst-case expected revenue over all product distributions consistent with the observed statistic. We show that simple and widely used mechanisms are robustly optimal. Specifically, posted pricing is robustly optimal given the distribution of the highest value; the Myerson auction designed for the unique consistent i.i.d. distribution, with uniformly random tie-breaking, is robustly optimal given the lowest value distribution; and the second-price auction with an optimal reserve is robustly optimal when an intermediate order statistic is observed and the implied i.i.d. distribution is regular above its reserve. translated_title: 匿名信息下的鲁棒机制设计
translated_abstract: 在实践中，拍卖数据往往是内生删失且匿名的，仅揭示有限的结果统计量而非完整的出价档案。我们研究了如下鲁棒拍卖设计问题：卖方仅观察到竞买人估值的单个匿名次序统计量的分布，并希望在所有与所观察统计量相一致的独立乘积分布中最大化最坏情况下的期望收益。我们证明了一些简单且广泛使用的机制是鲁棒最优的。具体而言：当给定最高估值的分布时，标价定价（posted pricing）是鲁棒最优的；当给定最低估值的分布时，为唯一一致的独立同分布所设计的 Myerson 拍卖（采用均匀随机平局裁决）是鲁棒最优的；当观察到中间的次序统计量且所隐含的独立同分布在其保留价之上满足正则性时，带最优保留价的第二价格拍卖是鲁棒最优的。在没有任何正则性……
tldr: 该论文证明，当卖方仅能观察到竞买人估值的单个匿名次序统计量分布时，标价定价（对应最高估值）、带均匀随机平局裁决的 Myerson 拍卖（对应最低估值）以及带最优保留价的第二价格拍卖（对应中间次序统计量）等简单常用机制在最大最小收益意义上是鲁棒最优的。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that under robust auction design where the seller observes only the distribution of a single anonymous order statistic, simple widely-used mechanisms—posted pricing for the highest value, the Myerson auction with uniform random tie-breaking for the lowest value, and the second-price auction with an optimal reserve for an intermediate order statistic—are robustly optimal in the maximin revenue sense.
